name: Weigh In
hint: A crate weighs as much as a friend, and it never gets bored.
why4: The outer plate needs 4 and there are only two crates, so two players must stand on it; the inner plate needs two more to hold the gate open for them.
solution: P3 and P4 wait right of the outer plate (x=17-18). P1 stands against the shelf at x=6; P2 jumps onto P1's head and onto the shelf (height 3).

P2 grabs the crate at x=2, walks off the shelf with it and drops it (Down+Grab) at the right end of the outer plate (x=16). P1 boosts P2 again for the crate at x=1; P2 drops it at x=15 and stays on the plate.
P1 walks onto the plate too: 2 crates + 2 players = 4/4, gate A at x=19 opens.
P3 and P4 walk in and stand on the inner plate at x=22-23 (2/2).

P2 picks up the crate in front of it (carried weight still counts), hops the other crate, walks in, jumps over P3 and P4 and sets the crate down against the 3-high key ledge (x=28). P1 hops the crate on the plate and walks in.
The crate is the step up the ledge that all four have to cross: crate (1) -> ledge top (2 more). P2 goes first and touches the key at x=30, then P4, P3, P1 follow.
Everyone jumps the 2-wide pit at x=35-36; P2 opens the door at x=41; all press Down.
Without the crate the last player cannot get over the ledge; if the crates were left on the plate, two hold the inner plate while the other two fetch one.
